snippet.title: Fishing Inc | Steam Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
We finally made a trailer for our game!  Fishing Inc is out now as a Demo on Steam.

✨Play Here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4126480/Fishing_Inc/?utm_source=Youtube&utm_medium=Trailer&utm_campaign=Organic

Join Our Community: https://discord.gg/WkAQxsz

Fishing Inc is a cozy incremental fishing game. Catch fish, upgrade your gear, and enjoy the nature. 

Wishlist and try the Demo today! We can’t wait to hear what you think.

#indiedev #gamedev #fishinggames #idle #steam
